phase_name: Whole-suite determinism and the complete gate set

objectives.description: Run the whole zotero-export suite under an outer 600s bound, confirm exit 0
Run run-all.sh (all suites, no --only), confirm the suite's new behavior holds under harness scheduling
Run the complete verify-deploy.sh gate set with no --skip-slow/--only-gate
Check for source-store/deployed-copy divergence, refresh if needed

approaches_tried.approach: Single foreground Bash call with inline `timeout N cmd` for run-all.sh and verify-deploy.sh
approaches_tried.reason: Both commands run well past the harness's own ~590-600s foreground tool-call ceiling, so the call was auto-backgrounded by the harness mid-command even though an inner `timeout 1200`/`timeout 2400` was already set. Switched to explicit nohup-detached background launch with a captured pid, polled via bounded `kill -0` loops across successive foreground Bash calls -- never ending a turn on an unresolved wait.

deviations.description: Run run-all.sh (all suites, no --only) and confirm exit 0
deviations.reason: run-all.sh terminated deterministically (not a hang) but exited non-zero: 4 of 144 suites failed, all pre-existing and unrelated to this task (test-detect-noop-bash.sh, test-guard-git-push.sh, test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh, test-four-tier-conflict.sh). test-zotero-generate-export.sh itself reported PASS.
